projects.name: Candidate AI Representative
projects.description: Built and deployed a full-stack, resume-grounded AI assistant that enables recruiters to ask questions about a candidate using the active resume and structured profile data. projects.name: AI-Powered Vector Database and RAG System

Built REST APIs for document management, semantic retrieval, and vector-search operations.
